description: Read the facts sheet behind one door grant a student shared: the door, the sums, the lines, the plain text, the page link if there is one, and the receipt id on any item that carries one, for a receiver's own agent to hand to verify_record. No login, no API key: the grant itself is the credential, and it unlocks exactly one door. An expired, revoked, or malformed grant refuses with the same plain message every time.

grant.description: The door grant a student shared, starting with efgdg_.

name: read_door
title: Read a shared door's facts
